subject: Consumption runway, expected monthly tokens & peak spike plan
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Ami Patel <ami@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consumption runway, expected monthly tokens & peak spike plan

Hi Ami — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on numbers for the hosted API pricing follow-up: 

Summary from our conversation:
- Primary integration: customer support triage + short-form summarization across 3 product lines.
- Target go-live (beta): mid-November.
- Core ask: confirm expected monthly token volume range and peak TPS (spike profile) so we can produce an accurate $/1M token pricing and SLA options.

You mentioned a conservative baseline and a potential spike pattern when marketing campaigns run. To move to a formal quote we need: 
1) Expected baseline monthly consumption (tokens/month) — rough range is fine (min/max).
2) Expected peak TPS during marketing spikes (sustained for ~30–60m windows).
3) Target budget $/1M tokens or $ monthly cap you’re aiming for (if any).

I attached a simple run-rate model you can edit to share your estimates (novacorp_runrate_model.xlsx). If you prefer, reply with numbers in-line and we’ll draft the hosted pricing bands and burst options.

Next steps:
- Ami: share baseline min/max tokens and typical spike TPS by EOD Wednesday (9/8).
- Redwood: we’ll turn those into 2 pricing scenarios (standard hosted + burst-capacity add-on) and send a draft quote + contract path.

Thanks — talk soon.

--
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
https://redwood.ai
From: Ami Patel <ami@novacorp.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: NovaCorp Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 17:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Consumption runway, expected monthly tokens & peak spike plan

Chloe — appreciate the clear recap. Numbers below from our internal ops convo this afternoon. I’m sharing conservative + optimistic columns. Procurement looped in on budget.

Baseline monthly tokens (conservative / optimistic):
- Conservative: 12M tokens/month
- Optimistic: 45M tokens/month

Peak TPS (marketing spike windows):
- Typical peak: 6–8 reqs/s sustained (~12–16 TPS assuming avg 2k tokens per request) for short bursts (5–15 mins).
- Campaign spike: up to 250 TPS sustained for 30–45 minutes (this is the upper bound our infra team has seen in similar rollouts).

Budget posture: internal target is $600 — $900 per 1M tokens for the first 6 months but open to structure (commit bands + burst overage pricing). Procurement also asked for an example of an invoice-friendly pricing line and commitment discounts.

I gave procurement edit rights on the run-rate file (you should have access). Let me know if you want clarification on token assumptions (we used 2k avg tokens/request).

Ami
Senior Product Manager, NovaCorp
ami@novacorp.com
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Ami Patel <ami@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 18:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consumption runway, expected monthly tokens & peak spike plan

Thanks — this is great, Ami. A few clarifying notes and what we’ll include in the draft: 

Clarifications:
- We’ll assume 2k tokens/request as you noted. If you anticipate longer prompts or multi-turn retention, flag that now.
- For the 250 TPS campaign spike: is that an upper bound with graceful degradation acceptable, or do you need hard SLOs at that level? (We can propose a burst SLA but it changes the pricing profile.)

What we’ll produce (by 9/9 EOD):
- Two pricing scenarios: 12M baseline and 45M baseline, each with 2 commitment bands and optional burst add-on for campaign windows.
- Unit economics: $/1M tokens for each band, plus example monthly invoice lines.
- Recommended concurrency/burst guardrails (how we would configure burst capacity and fallbacks).

I attached a draft pricing PDF so procurement can see formatting for an invoice-friendly line (redwood_pricing_draft.pdf).

If Karthik and Marissa have anything to add on SLA/burst mechanics, happy to fold in.

Best,
Chloe
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 18:42:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Draft pricing approach for NovaCorp

(Internal note) Quick alignment before we send final doc:
- For 12M baseline: propose $850 / 1M tokens with 10% discount on 12-month commit, burst add-on billed at premium (x1.8) for reserved burst pool.
- For 45M baseline: propose $680 / 1M tokens with 15% discount on 12-month commit, burst add-on at x1.5.
- Campaign spike: offer a temporary burst agreement (pre-paid burst capacity that auto-replenishes) to avoid noisy overage billing.

Will finish the draft pricing lines and hand to Chloe to share.

—Karthik
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: NovaCorp Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Ami Patel <ami@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consumption runway, expected monthly tokens & peak spike plan

Chloe / Team — procurement here. Quick confirmations and a request: 

Confirmations:
- Budget target: NovaCorp is comfortable with a $600–$900 / 1M token band for initial term.
- We prefer invoice-line item pricing (units and $/1M) with a monthly cap option.

Request:
- Please send a single-page pricing annex that we can attach to our PO, showing: baseline band, committed discount, burst add-on pricing, and an example month with 45M tokens and a single 30-minute 250 TPS campaign (showing how overage or pre-paid burst would be billed).
- Also include standard data residency and retention language for hosted API (we will attach a short e-sig for acceptance once pricing aligns).

If you can deliver the annex and example invoice by EOD today (9/8), we can circulate internally and aim to have a PO issued by next week.

Thanks — looking forward.

Procurement Team
NovaCorp
[Attachment: PO-template.docx (document)]
